title: 2013 AMC 12B Problem 7
statement: Jo and Blair take turns counting from \(1\) to one more than the last number said by the other person. Jo starts by saying “\(1\)”, so Blair follows by saying “\(1,\) \(2\)”. Jo then says “\(1,\) \(2,\) \(3\)”, and so on. What is the \(53\)rd number said?

solutions.text: After the turn that counts up to \(n,\) exactly \(1 + 2 + \cdots + n = \tfrac12 n(n+1)\) numbers have been said. For \(n = 9\) that is \(45.\) The next turn starts \(1, 2, \ldots,\) so the \(53\)rd number is the \(8\)th number of that turn, namely \(8.\) Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The turn that ends at \(n\) consists of someone saying \(1, 2, \ldots, n\)
After the turn ending at \(n,\) a total of \(\tfrac12 n(n+1)\) numbers have been said
